findings.rationale: A3.4 step 9: in a store repo every commit and merge runs hippo check whatever paths it touches; without hippo pre-commit and pre-merge-commit exit 1; post-merge/post-rewrite always mark when they cannot check; unrelated-commit and non-.hippo merge cases added; KR-A3.4 updated.
A3.2 rule A now judges clauses: exempt only when the verb's object is project-record.js or a hippo read; mixed read/hand-edit fixture exits 1.

C6 now scrubs GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY, GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES, GIT_PREFIX, pins GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and pre-flights rev-parse --show-toplevel per temp repo.

Section 3.3: spool entries record worktree, branch and target; flush replays only matching entries under an O_EXCL lock with stale-pid recovery; A3.1 adds concurrent-flush and cross-worktree tests, red-checked.

Ledger is the single owner of one-way decisions: A3.4 step 6 runs only in hippo/hippo-problems/spool, skips rows with source project-record, passes --key from the ledger row id; files-mode decision new marks its row; W20 text updated; tests for one row / one record.

backlog_frozen is per commit (pre-commit staged vs HEAD; pre-push each commit of the push range vs first parent), checked only when the parent tree has repo.toml; notices move into the store commit; a commit deleting repo.toml (rollback) is exempt; controls added.
Marker moved to the per-worktree git dir; two-worktree case added.
post-rewrite chain line added running the post-merge logic; fast-forward covered by post-merge; rebase case added.
C1 gains a scoped exception for hippo-sandbox.sh fixtures in sandbox temp repos with a tempdir assertion.
Same fold as the rule A clause change; mixed writer/hand-edit fixture exits 1.
C8 now puts scripts- and hook-inventory rows in the wiring commit; mechanism commits hold code and tests only.
A3.4 acceptance adds red-checked min_plugin_version, marker, problems and spool lines and the migrate refusal; A3.7 mirror-exclusion test is red-checked.
A3.6 cells run with a deny rule on the credential path; the checker refuses transcripts with the path or token-shaped strings; planted negative control added.
Added to the P1.4 input list in section 7: once hippo init exists, new/import refuse without repo.toml.
